editorial.title: kaniko lookalike registry hosts can receive a build’s Azure access token
editorial.summary: The Chainguard kaniko fork’s advisory describes Azure access-token exposure when untrusted Dockerfiles or build arguments reference lookalike registry hosts and an Azure identity is available. Its bundled credential helper can send a token to an attacker-controlled registry.
editorial.why_it_matters: Build inputs can cross the Azure identity trust boundary. Inventory both the executor and warmer, rather than assuming a separate credential-helper deployment is required.
editorial.action: Rebuild the executor, warmer and standalone ACR helper from kaniko v1.25.20 or later. Keep Azure identities away from untrusted builds and review Azure activity for exposed identities.
